children.name: text
children: the Principal will pay the Contractor the Contract Sum for, and the Contractor will, carry out, complete and (where applicable) remedy, the Works in accordance with this Agreement;

children.name: text
children: This Agreement contains the entire agreement between the Parties and supersedes any previous agreements, negotiations, representations and understandings between the Parties; and

children.name: text
children: In the event of any conflict between Schedule 1 and Schedule 2, the terms of Schedule 1 shall prevail.

children.name: text
children: Bonds are not required under this Contract.
Guarantees are to be provided by the Contractor in the form of standard industry guarantees.

children.name: text
children: A Principal's Representative is appointed to act on behalf of the Principal in all matters related to this agreement. The Principal's Representative obligations shall be in accordance with those obligations set-out in NZS3910-2013, Clause 6.

children.name: text
children: {b:Signed and agreed to by Parties involved:}

children.name: text
children: "Agreement" means this agreement, including Schedule 1, Schedule 2 and any annexed plans and diagrams.

children.name: text
children: "Authority" means any local body, government or other authority having jurisdiction or authority in connection with the land comprising the Site, the Site, or the Works, and includes any Network Utility Operator as defined in the Resource Management Act 1991.

children.name: text
children: "Contract Sum" means, unless otherwise stated in this Agreement, the fixed lump sum price for the Works outlined in Schedule 1 and payable in New Zealand currency, and with no provision for adjustment for cost fluctuations or currency movements.

children.name: text
children: "HSW Legislation" means any legislation that regulates health and safety, currently being the Health and Safety at Work Act 2015, and includes all its associated regulations and approved codes of practice and any replacement HSW Legislation.

children.name: text
children: "Personnel" means staff, employees, contractors and/or agents of the Contractor involved in or relevant to the Works.

children.name: text
children: "Project" means the project referred to in Schedule 1.

children.name: text
children: "Site" means the land and other places on or over or under which the Works are to be carried out.

children.name: text
children: "Services" shall include all things to be done and all temporary work, plant and materials to be supplied in order to complete the Works as shown on the drawings or described in Schedule 1.

children.name: text
children: "Working Day" means a calendar day exclusive of Saturdays and Sundays, statutory holidays applicable to Wellington, New Zealand or any day falling within the period from 24 December to 5 January both days inclusive.

children.name: text
children: "Works" means all things to be done and all temporary work, plant and materials to be supplied in order to complete the Works as shown on the drawings and/or described in Schedule 1.

children.name: text
children: Bonds are not required under the Contract.

children.name: text
children: Where required by Schedule 1, the Contractor shall provide guarantees in the form required by the Principal or the Principle's Representative. These documents, properly executed, must be returned with the signed Agreement (or at another time agreed in writing with the Contractor) and the Contractor is not entitled to any payment or further payment under the Agreement until these properly executed documents are provided to the Principal or the Principle's Representative.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor will perform the Services and carry out, complete and (where applicable) remedy the Works in accordance with the Programme and this Agreement. For the avoidance of doubt, the Contractor will provide at its own cost all labour, materials, services, temporary works, scaffolding, equipment and plant required for the proper and timely execution and completion of the Works.

children.name: text
children: The Works will be to a reasonable standard and quality, and fit for purposes for which the Works of the type in question are commonly supplied;

children.name: text
children: The Services will be carried out in accordance with good trade practice;

children.name: text
children: In providing the Services, the Contractor will exercise the degree of skill and care that would reasonably be expected from a reputable, competent and skilled person experienced in carrying out activities of a similar nature, scope and complexity to the Services under this Agreement;

children.name: text
children: Any good, materials or other products supplied or used by it in carrying out the Works:
i) are new, of good quality, and suitable for the intended purpose; and
ii) are free of any security interests, liens, charges or other encumbrances.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall comply in all respects with all relevant legislation, regulation, by-law, licence, permit or consent applicable to the Works.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall not be required to obtain any consents, licences, permits or approval required for the Works unless as otherwise agreed by the Parties in writing.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall provide, at its own cost, all the services required for testing, commissioning and operation of the Works, unless stated to the contrary in Schedule 1.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor must prepare all documentation required for the Works including, but not limited to, 'As Built' Drawings, QA / QC records, O&M Manual, test results, producer statements, inspection records, and certifications as appropriate to the trade. All documentation must be supplied in a timely manner and, unless otherwise agreed, must be supplied in both hard copy and in digital format specified by the Principal or the Principle's Representative.

children.name: text
children: Prior to completion of the Works, the Contractor must supply a producer statement construction in a form acceptable to the Authority. The Contractor must also supply any other documentation required to obtain a code of compliance certificate or certificate of public use that is the responsibility of the Contractor. Documentation required for compliance must be supplied in a timely manner so as not to delay the Principal or the Principle's Representative progressing applications with the consent authority.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor must comply with all reasonable written instructions issued by the Principal or the Principle's Representative and must not accept any instruction from any other party, unless as authorised by the Principal or the Principle's Representative in writing.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor must not discuss any matters relating to the Project or the Works with the media or third parties unless authorised by the Principal or the Principle's Representative in writing.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall be granted non-exclusive access to the Site sufficient only for the execution of the Works.

children.name: text
children: The Principal shall provide temporary single phase power and water supply to one location on the Site. The Contractor shall be responsible for its own distribution of the power and water to their workplace including other temporary power requirements, including transformers, extension leads, electrical equipment and plant and tools necessary for carrying out the Works.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall be responsible for its own task lighting.

children.name: text
children: The Principal or the Principle's Representative shall provide primary grid control points and datum levels only. The Contractor shall be responsible for the setting out of their own work from these control points.

children.name: text
children: Materials and plant may be stored on site at the discretion of the Principal or the Principle's Representative (acting reasonably). The Contractor is to ensure that all materials are properly stored, covered as necessary and protected from exposure to the weather, dust or other adverse conditions that may cause damage. If it is necessary to move this plant or material so work can proceed in a particular area, the Contractor must move the items within 24 hours of being given notice to do so or within such other time as may be mutually agreed.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor must take all necessary precautions to prevent or minimise nuisance from water, noise, smoke, dust, exhaust fumes, rubbish or any other cause resulting from execution of the Works. The lighting of fires on the Site is strictly prohibited. Noise emissions are not to exceed the limits set by any applicable legislation or bylaw or regulation or rule imposed by any authority having jurisdiction.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor will maintain a safe, clean and clear working area and must ensure all its rubbish is removed promptly to centrally placed rubbish bins provided by the Principal. In addition, the Contractor will provide reasonable assistance to the Principal to ensure all other communal areas of the site are maintained to the same safe, clean and clear standard.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor will provide reasonable protection of the Works, including, but not limited to, from weather, dampness, theft, and/or vandalism, until completion of the Works (which will be determined by the Principal or the Principle's Representative acting reasonably).

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall comply in all respects with the health and safety provisions of the Agreement and the HSW Legislation.

children.name: text
children: Prior to the commencement of the Works, the Contractor shall:

children.name: text
children: ensure that all its Personnel attend all relevant safety briefings and Site safety inductions, and have been trained and/or certified on health and safety matters relevant to the Services and/or as required by the Principal or the Principle's Representative;

children.name: text
children: provide to the Principal or the Principle's Representative a Personnel skills and competency training register confirming the training of all Personnel in the safe use of all plant, equipment, chemicals, substances, and products which will be, or which may reasonably be, used in the Works;

children.name: text
children: submit to the Principal or the Principle's Representative for approval, a detailed and comprehensive health and safety plan ("{b:Contractor's Health and Safety Plan}"), which shall include the following and other such matters as the Principal or the Principle's Representative may reasonably require:

children.name: text
children: compliance with the Principal's Health and Safety plans and/or policies and Site safety rules as notified to the Contractor from time to time;

children.name: text
children: compliance with the HSW Legislation, including any applicable approved codes of practice;

children.name: text
children: procedures for the identification, recording and notification to the Principal of hazards (including WorkSafe New Zealand notification requirements for particular hazardous activities) and avoiding or minimising the effects of them;

children.name: text
children: procedures for the recording, dealing with, investigating, and notifying the Principal or the Principle's Representative of all accidents and incidents that harm or may have harmed any persons on the Site or otherwise engaged in the Works, together with steps to be taken to prevent the recurrence of any such accidents or incidents;

children.name: text
children: set out a detailed risk control plan;

children.name: text
children: set out, where applicable, a risk assessment and a Safe Working Method Statement for critical risk and critical risk activities;

children.name: text
children: set out procedures and plans for emergencies;

children.name: text
children: identification of all test and safety equipment and protective clothing to be used or available for the Works, locations and procedures for their use, and contact details for first aiders; and

children.name: text
children: an individual to be nominated on behalf of the Contractor, who shall be responsible for all health and safety requirements at the Site.

children.name: text
children: Where the Principal or the Principle's Representative does not approve the Contractor's Health and Safety Plan (acting reasonably), the Principal or the Principle's Representative will promptly notify the Contractor and set out the reasons why such approval is not given.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall promptly resubmit the Contractor's Health and Safety Plan, having addressed all such areas of non-compliance to the reasonable satisfaction of the Principal or the Principle's Representative.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other provision of the Agreement, the Contractor shall not be entitled to any payment under this Agreement until the Contractor's Health and Safety Plan has been submitted to, and approved by, the Principal or the Principle's Representative.

children.name: text
children: Without limiting the Principal's obligations under this clause, the Contractor will –

children.name: text
children: take all practicable steps to ensure the health and safety of its Personnel and any person on or in the vicinity of the Site;

children.name: text
children: do all things necessary to assist the Principal in discharging its health and safety obligations under the HSW Legislation;

children.name: text
children: refrain from doing anything that may impede or hinder the Principal in discharging its health and safety obligations under the Head Contract (if any) and under the HSW Legislation;

children.name: text
children: co-operate collectively in relation to health and safety with the Principal and all other parties on the Site;

children.name: text
children: comply with the Contractor's Health and Safety Plan as approved by the Principal;

children.name: text
children: have in place effective methods to identify risks to health and safety and communicate those risks and management strategies to the Principal, all Personnel, and any person on the Site;

children.name: text
children: take all practicable steps (as defined under the HSW Legislation) to eliminate or, if this is not possible, minimise risks to health and safety;

children.name: text
children: If required by the Principal or the Principle's Representative, develop and supply a risk assessment and a Safe Working Method Statement for critical risk and critical risk activities (including holding daily pre-start meetings for critical risk activities);

children.name: text
children: in addition to notifying the relevant statutory entity, immediately advise the Principal or the Principle's Representative verbally of any Notifiable Incident or Notifiable Event (as defined by the HSW Legislation), and as soon as possible
after the incident provide the Principal or the Principle's Representative with the following:

children.name: text
children: written details of the Notifiable Incident or Notifiable Event;

children.name: text
children: written details of steps taken or to be taken to eliminate or minimise the risks associated with that Notifiable Incident or Notifiable Event; and

children.name: text
children: a copy of any notice given to any relevant statutory entity;

children.name: text
children: maintain an appropriate level of Site supervision over its Personnel and/or any person on the Site;

children.name: text
children: maintain all plant in appropriate and safe working order, and plant shall be certified to that effect where appropriate; and

children.name: text
children: if required by the Principal or the Principle's Representative, implement an audit and inspection regime to ensure compliance with its health and safety obligations under the Agreement, and provide reports, in a form and containing such information as is required by the Principal or the Principle's Representative (acting reasonably), to confirm that the audit and inspection regime has been undertaken and any non-compliance by the Contractor of its health and safety obligations under the Agreement have been identified and remedied.

children.name: text
children: all of its Personnel may be selected by the Principal or the Principle's Representative for random drug and/or alcohol screening or testing;

children.name: text
children: any such random screening and/or testing shall be carried out by NZQA Qualified Collectors who will collect specimens, conduct on-site screening test using a fully verified device and processes which comply with appropriate standards;

children.name: text
children: any Personnel that refuse to participate in random drug and/or alcohol screening or testing shall be immediately excluded from the Site;

children.name: text
children: Any positive results in any random drug and/or alcohol screening and/or testing shall be notified to the Principal or the Principle's Representative. Any Personnel who return positive results may be excluded permanently from the Site.

children.name: text
children: In the event that any Personnel refuse testing/screening or receive positive results from the testing/screening under this clause, the Contractor will be liable for the full costs incurred by the Principal arising from, and in connection with, the relevant screening, testing and any medical examination.

children.name: text
children: If the Principal or the Principle's Representative considers that:

children.name: text
children: an unsafe work practice is being undertaken by the Contractor or any of its Personnel; or

children.name: text
children: unsafe conditions exist at the Site; or

children.name: text
children: there is a serious risk to health and safety at the Site; or

children.name: text
children: actual or potential damage to the Site is likely,

children.name: text
children: then the Principal or the Principle's Representative may order the Contractor to suspend work at the Site immediately. This clause will be in addition to the Principal's other rights and remedies under the Agreement (including any applicable indemnities) and at law.

children.name: text
children: If the Principal or the Principle's Representative considers that any Contractor or any of its Personnel:

children.name: text
children: Has, or is likely to, fail to comply with or carry out any reasonable health and safety direction given by the Principal or the Principle's Representative; and/or

children.name: text
children: Has, or is likely to, fail to comply with, or otherwise breach, any health and safety obligation under the Agreement and/or the HSW Legislation,

children.name: text
children: then the Principal or the Principle's Representative may (acting reasonably) order in writing the immediate removal of the Contractor and/or any Personnel. This clause will be in addition to the Principal's other rights and remedies under the Agreement (including any applicable indemnities) and at law.

children.name: text
children: Before commencing the Works, and before any payment is made to the Contractor, the Contractor shall forward to the Principal or the Principle's Representative certificates of insurance for all insurances that the Contractor is required to put into effect under Schedule 1.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall bear the deductible stated in any of the insurance policies required to be effected by either party under this section for every claim arising through the fault of the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The insurances to be effected by the Contractor are to be arranged on the basis that they are primary to and shall respond to in priority to any policy effected by the Principal which insure similar interests.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall use all due diligence to ensure that the insurances obtained by the Principal are not invalidated and that the premium for such insurances is not increased as a result of any acts or omissions on the part of the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Where Schedule 1 requires the Contractor to put in place Contract Works Insurance, it shall insure the Works, temporary works on or adjacent to the Site, materials intended for incorporation in the Works for an amount not less than their full contract value plus thirty percent.

children.name: text
children: Such Contract Works Insurance cover shall be in the joint names of the Contractor and the Principal for their respective rights and interest. All rights of subrogation shall be waived and coinsurance, cross liability and innocent breach of conditions provisions shall be included and shall be effected with an insurer on terms acceptable to the Principal.

children.name: text
children: Unless expressly stated otherwise Schedule 1, the Contractor shall put in place Public Liability insurance for damage to property, or liability to any persons which may arise out of or in consequence of the construction and maintenance of the Works, temporary works or additional and/or ancillary works and against all claims, demands, proceedings, damages, costs, charges or expenses whatsoever in respect of such works for up to the sum stated in Schedule 1.

children.name: text
children: The Public Liability insurance effected by the Contractor must extend to cover damage or loss to any of the Principal's existing structures (if any) and their contents in the vicinity of the Works.

children.name: text
children: The Public Liability insurance cover shall be in the joint names of the Principal and the Contractor for their respective rights and interest, all rights of subrogation shall be waived and co insurance, cross liability and innocent breach of conditions provisions included and shall be effected with an insurer and on terms acceptable to the Principal.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall maintain the Public Liability insurance cover throughout the duration of the Works.

children.name: text
children: The excess/deductible, exclusions, limitations, warranties, and the terms and conditions set out in the policy shall be subject to the approval of the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Unless expressly stated otherwise in the Specific Conditions, the Contractor shall effect motor vehicle liability insurance for liabilities arising from the use of any motor vehicle belonging to or under the care, custody or control of the Contractor in connection with the execution of Works.

children.name: text
children: The Principal or the Principle’s Representative shall be entitled to vary the Works, including by increasing, decreasing, changing, or deleting in its entirety the Works, by written notice to the Contractor where the Principal or the Principle’s Representative considers (at its absolute discretion) that such a variation is necessary to ensure the completion of the Works.

children.name: text
children: The Principal or the Principle’s Representative shall not be liable for loss of profits or any other damages arising from any such variations or deletions.

children.name: text
children: If a variation is made under this clause, the Agreement Sum will be adjusted accordingly by the Principal or the Principle’s Representative (acting reasonably and in good faith).

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall (to the maximum extent permitted by law) indemnify the Principal (and keep the Principal so indemnified) on demand from and against:

children.name: text
children: any claim, proceeding, action, cause of action, demand or suit (including by way of contribution or indemnity) whether under or in connection with any contract or otherwise at law, under statute or in equity, including in tort (whether for negligence or otherwise); and

children.name: text
children: any cost, expense, loss, damage or liability whether direct, indirect or consequential (including pure economic loss), present or future, fixed or unascertained, actual or contingent; and

children.name: text
children: only to the extent not prohibited by applicable law, any fine or penalty, in each case to the extent arising out of, or as a consequence of, the Contractor breaching any obligation under this Agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Principal or the Principle’s Representative will not be liable for any consequential or indirect loss (including pure economic loss, loss of business and loss of profits) arising out of, or as a consequence of, this Agreement, any tort (including negligence) or otherwise at law.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other term in this Agreement, the Principal will only be liable to the Contractor, whether under any contract, under statute or in equity, including in tort (whether for negligence or otherwise), or otherwise at law, for a maximum value of the Contract Sum (as varied from time to time in accordance with this Agreement).

children.name: text
children: Unless otherwise stated in Schedule 1, the Contractor may issue payment claims at monthly intervals for work to the end of any month and must be received by the 20th of that month.

children.name: text
children: Where the Contractor serves a payment claim later than the due date for serving payment claims, then the payment claim shall be deemed to be served on the next due date for serving payment claims.

children.name: text
children: The Principal or the Principle's Representative shall provide a payment schedule to the Contractor in respect of each payment claim.

children.name: text
children: The payment schedule shall be set out the amount of the payment claim less any retentions or other deductions or set-offs or variations pursuant to any right of the Principal under the Agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Principal shall pay the Contractor the scheduled amount in any payment schedule no later than 22 Working Days after the end of the claim month.

children.name: text
children: Unless otherwise stated in Schedule 1, the Contractor shall serve the final payment claim on the Principal or the Principle's Representative no later than one month after the completion of the Works.

children.name: text
children: The Principal shall not be required to make a final payment to the Contractor until the Contractor signs and completes the release letter, guarantees and all other documentation required by the Agreement and delivers them to the Principal or the Principle's Representative.

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor considers itself to be entitled to any additional payment, under this Agreement or otherwise in connection with the Agreement, the Contractor shall give notice to the Principal or the Principle's Representative, describing the event or circumstance giving rise to the claim. The notice shall be given as soon as practicable, and not later than 10 Working Days after the Contractor became aware, or should have become aware, of the event or circumstance. If the Contractor fails to give notice of a claim within such period, the time for completion of the Works shall not be extended, the Contractor shall not be entitled to additional payment, and the Principal shall be discharged from all liability in connection with the claim.

children.name: text
children: The Principal may set off against any amounts due to the Contractor under the Agreement any amounts due to the Principal by the Contractor under the Agreement or any other contract between the Principal and the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor fails to comply with the Programme and this affects the programme or plans under the Head Contract (if any), then the Principal shall have the right to obtain all the necessary resources such as labour, materials, plant and other services in order to for the Programme to be complied with. Invoking this clause will be without prejudice to the Principal's other rights and remedies under this Agreement (including any indemnities) and at law.

children.name: text
children: If a dispute arises between the Principal and the Contractor, in connection with or arising out of the Works, the Principal and the Contractor shall firstly attempt to resolve the dispute by good faith negotiation between the Parties. Should resolution not be achieved within 10 Working Days of the initiation of the process, either party may, by written notice, require the matter in dispute be referred to mediation. If no agreement or settlement has been reached within 20 Working Days, or such further time as the parties may agree, from the date of the notice requiring mediation, then either party may, by written notice, require that the matter in dispute be referred to arbitration in accordance with this Agreement.

children.name: text
children: If permitted by the Agreement, either party may, by written notice, require the matter in dispute be referred immediately to arbitration before a sole arbitrator to be agreed between the parties, subject to and in accordance with the provisions of the Arbitration Act 1996.

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor commits any of the following defaults:
a) fails to proceed with the Works with reasonable diligence; or
b) is unable to complete the volume of work as required by the Programme; or
c) refuses or persistently neglects after notice in writing from the Principal or the Principle's Representative to remove defective work or improper material,

then, if such default continues for 5 Working Days after the Principal or the Principle's Representative has given written notice to the Contractor specifying the default and stating that notice is given under this clause, the Principal or the Principle's Representative may, without prejudice to any other rights or remedies, by written notice terminate the Agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Principal or the Principle's Representative may, without prejudice to any other rights or remedies, by written notice to the Contractor immediately terminate the Agreement if:

a) the Contractor commits an act of bankruptcy, or makes or enters into any arrangement or composition with its creditors, or being a company is placed into receivership or statutory management, or enters into liquidation whether compulsory or voluntary, or suffers or allows any execution to be levied on its property or obtained against it; or
b) Any agreement between the Principal and Contractor relevant to the Works and for which this Agreement is based is terminated for any reason.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall not assign or subcontract all or any part of the Works without the written consent of the Principal or the Principle's Representative. Such consent shall not be unreasonably withheld. No assignment or subcontracting shall affect or limit the responsibility of the Contractor to complete the Works and to comply with all the terms and conditions in the Agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall ensure that each of its subcontractors is bound to observe similar contractual obligations to those which bind the Contractor in the Agreement.

children.name: text
children: {b:Notices:} Except where otherwise provided, any notice shall be deemed to be sufficiently given if sent by post, email or facsimile or hand delivered to the addresses stated in the Agreement or as subsequently advised in writing.

children.name: text
children: {b:Waiver:} No waiver or amendment of any provision of the Agreement shall be effective unless it is recorded in writing and has been signed by both parties. Any waiver shall only affect the matter that it expressly refers to and shall not apply to any other or later matter.

children.name: text
children: {b:Relationship between the parties:} Nothing in this Agreement shall create, constitute or evidence any partnership, joint venture, agency, trust or employer/employee relationship between any of the parties, and a party may not make, or allow to be made, any representation that any such relationship exists between any of the parties. A party shall not have the authority to act for, or to incur any obligation on behalf of, any other party, except as expressly provided for in this Agreement.

children.name: text
children: {b:Counterparts:} This Agreement may be executed and exchanged in any number of counterparts (including copies, facsimile copies and scanned email copies) each of which is to be deemed an original, but all of which together are to constitute a binding and enforceable agreement between the Parties.

children.name: text
children: {b:Severability:} If any term or provision of this Agreement or its application to any person or circumstances is, to any extent, held to be invalid or unenforceable, the remainder of this Agreement or the application of such term or provision to any other persons or circumstances will not be affected, and each term and provision of this Agreement will be valid and enforceable to the maximum extent permitted by law.

children.name: text
children: {b:Governing Law:} The Agreement shall be governed by New Zealand law
